source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Multilevel Inheritance with Figure 3.5, the Vehicle/Car/ElectricCar program, its output, Code Explanation and the Class Activity (PDF 42-43, printed 38-39).

blocks.text: Jab aik class aisi class se inherit kare jo khud kisi aur se derived (bani hui) hai, to khandani shajre (family tree) jaisi zanjeer banti hai (Grandparent → Parent → Child). Is mein "grandchild" class apne parent aur grandparent dono ke tamam methods aur attributes istemal kar sakti hai (Figure 3.5). (Kitab mein 'derived' ki jagah 'drived' chhapa hai; yeh spelling ki chhoti ghalti hai.)

blocks.alt: Multilevel inheritance: teen dabbe aik column mein: oopar Grand Parent Class, beech mein Parent Class, neeche Child Class; har neeche wali class oopar wali se khokhle teer wali lakeer se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5: Multilevel Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Is misal mein ElectricCar, Car se inherit karti hai, aur Car khud Vehicle se inherit karti hai.

Engine started.
Car is driving.
Battery is charging.
blocks.caption: Output (program chala kar)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Vehicle:": sab se oopar wali class (grandparent); method start_engine().
"class Car(Vehicle):": Car, Vehicle se inherit karti hai (parent); apna method drive().
"class ElectricCar(Car):": ElectricCar, Car se inherit karti hai (child); apna method charge(). Yun zanjeer banti hai: Vehicle → Car → ElectricCar.
"my_tesla = ElectricCar()": sab se neeche wali class ka object.
"my_tesla.start_engine()" Vehicle se, "my_tesla.drive()" Car se, aur "my_tesla.charge()" ElectricCar ka apna.
Output: teen lines: "Engine started.", "Car is driving." aur "Battery is charging.".
Khud try karein: aakhir mein "Car().charge()" likh kar Run karein: AttributeError aayega, kyun ke Car ke paas charge() nahi; inheritance oopar se neeche aati hai, neeche se oopar nahi.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aik Vehicle class banayein aur us se Car aur Bike subclasses banayein. Har subclass mein apna alag method dalein aur inheritance chala kar dikhayein.

items: Multilevel: zanjeer Grandparent → Parent → Child (Vehicle → Car → ElectricCar).
Neeche wali class oopar ki tamam classes ke methods istemal kar sakti hai.
